t1.speaker: tobi
t1.text: D-don't hurt me! The veil-man said a samurai would come for thieves.

t2.speaker: tobi
t2.text: I only take bread for my sister. The bakery throws it out anyway!

choices.text: I'm not here for you. Go home.

t_kind.speaker: tobi
t_kind.text: You're... really not like the others.

t_key.speaker: tobi
t_key.text: I found this in the Lamplighter's old house. He said it's the city's key, and to give it to someone who'd use it to go home. That's you, right?

t_got.speaker: narrator
t_got.text: A street kid's trust. It weighs more than the key.

t_sis.speaker: tobi
t_sis.text: ...Can I ask you something? My sister Suzu went into the fog two nights ago. She said the Lamplighter would walk her home, like always. He didn't come.

t_sis2.speaker: tobi
t_sis2.text: Widow Mei knows the fog roads. She's at the market by the lantern stall. Ask her? Please?

t_cruel.speaker: narrator
t_cruel.text: You did what the Master wanted. The boy didn't scream. That was the worst part.

after_kind.speaker: tobi
after_kind.text: Did Widow Mei say anything? Suzu's scared of the dark. She's been out there two whole nights.

light.speaker: tobi
light.text: That's... the apprentice's lantern! Mei's husband's! Light it - Suzu always follows lanterns!

light2.speaker: narrator
light2.text: You raise the lantern. The flame leans into the fog as if it's listening. Somewhere far off, small footsteps turn around.

light3.speaker: narrator
light3.text: A girl with soot on her cheeks steps out of the fog, blinking, and walks straight into her brother's arms.

light4.speaker: tobi
light4.text: SUZU! ...Thank you. Thank you. Here - Suzu kept these for the Lamplighter. Medicine. He doesn't need it anymore, right?

after_home.speaker: tobi
after_home.text: Suzu's asleep. First time in two nights. She drew you again - same big hat. Mei should keep the lantern. It's her husband's.

post.speaker: tobi
post.text: The fog's coming back thicker. Suzu's scared it'll take her again. ...The Lamplighter's not coming anymore, is he?

choices.text: No. But someone will carry the lantern.

post_hope.speaker: tobi
post_hope.text: ...You? Then go tell Widow Mei. She'll want to know someone's still walking people home.

post_no.speaker: narrator
post_no.text: Tobi nods, very seriously, and goes to sit closer to his sister.
